events.title: Frontier Safety Framework v2 Released
events.description: Google DeepMind releases updated Frontier Safety Framework with refined CCL definitions and alert thresholds.

events.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro Released
events.description: Google DeepMind releases Gemini 2.5 Pro, first model to reach alert threshold in cybersecurity CCL.

events.title: First Alert Threshold Reached - Cybersecurity
events.description: Gemini 2.5 Pro reaches alert threshold for cybersecurity CCL. Precautionary mitigations deployed despite not crossing actual CCL.

events.title: Frontier Safety Framework v3 Released
events.description: Major update to FSF adds new harmful manipulation CCL and strengthens evaluation protocols. Addresses manipulation risks and potential AI shutdown interference.

events.title: Gemini 3 Flash Released
events.description: Google DeepMind releases Gemini 3 Flash with improved efficiency. Alert threshold active in cybersecurity.

events.title: Gemini 3 Pro Released
events.description: Google DeepMind releases Gemini 3 Pro with comprehensive FSF evaluation. Alert threshold confirmed in cybersecurity, but CCL not crossed based on v2 benchmark.

events.title: No CCLs Crossed - Precautionary Mitigations Maintained
events.description: Gemini 3 Pro FSF report confirms no Critical Capability Levels have been met. Alert thresholds active in cybersecurity. Precautionary mitigations remain in place.
